title: Expressivity In Multimodal Contrastive Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.17203v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Contrastive learning has become a cornerstone of modern representation learning, powering CLIP-style models that underpin text-to-image generation, vision-language models, and retrieval across a rapidly growing range of modalities. Despite this empirical success, the expressive power of these architectures remains poorly understood. To gain insight, we study expressivity by adopting a population-level, density-estimation viewpoint: each architecture comprises a parameterized set of densities whose parameters may be chosen to approximate the joint distribution of the modalities. This isolates a question of pure representational capacity: which joint distributions can a given contrastive family of parameterizations approximate to arbitrary accuracy? translated_title: 多模态对比学习中的表达力
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17203v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：对比学习已成为现代表示学习的基石，支撑着CLIP风格模型，这些模型为文本到图像生成、视觉-语言模型以及跨快速扩展的多种模态的检索提供动力。尽管取得了这些实证上的成功，但这些架构的表达能力仍然鲜为人知。为了获得洞察，我们通过采用群体层面、密度估计的视角来研究表达力：每个架构包含一组参数化的密度，其参数可以选择以近似模态的联合分布。这隔离了一个纯粹的表征容量问题：给定对比族参数化能近似哪些联合分布到任意精度？我们表明，表达力严格依赖于架构。对于两种模态，简单的双塔CLIP架构是一个通用近似器。CLIP的一种自然泛化，被广泛使用。
tldr: 本文通过密度估计视角，证明双塔CLIP架构在两种模态下是通用近似器，但表达力强烈依赖于架构设计，揭示了多模态对比学习的表征容量边界。
en_tdlr: This paper adopts a density-estimation viewpoint to show that the two-tower CLIP architecture is a universal approximator for two modalities, while expressivity is sharply architecture-dependent, revealing capacity boundaries in multimodal contrastive learning.
